'''Stanislas Ouaro''' (born 19 January 1975<ref name="buffalo"/>) is a [[Burkina Faso|Burkinabé]] politician and mathematician.

==Biography==
Stanislas Ouaro was born on 19 January 1975. He graduated with a doctor's degree from [[University of Ouagadougou]] in 2001 with his thesis titled ''Etude de problèmes elliptiques-paraboliques nonlinéaires en une dimension d'espace''.<ref name="buffalo">{{cite web| url= http://www.math.buffalo.edu/mad/PEEPS2/ouaro_stanislas.html |title= Stanislas OUARO |work= Mathematicians of the African Diaspora |accessdate= 24 March 2020}}</ref> Before he joined government, he was the president of {{ill|University of Ouaga II|fr|Université Ouaga II}} since 2012.<ref>{{cite web| url= https://www.gouvernement.gov.bf/gouvernement/membres-de-gouvernement/details?tx_news_pi1%5Baction%5D=detail&tx_news_pi1%5Bcontroller%5D=News&tx_news_pi1%5Bnews%5D=82&cHash=20e76bf7364db59a506ba424c601ca61 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200324102331/https://www.gouvernement.gov.bf/gouvernement/membres-de-gouvernement/details?tx_news_pi1%5Baction%5D=detail&tx_news_pi1%5Bcontroller%5D=News&tx_news_pi1%5Bnews%5D=82&cHash=20e76bf7364db59a506ba424c601ca61 |archive-date=24 March 2020 |title= Stanislas OUARO, Ministre de l'Éducation Nationale, de l'Alphabétisation et de la Promotion des langues nationales |work= Gouvernement du Burkina Faso |accessdate= 24 March 2020 |language=fr}}</ref>

On 31 January 2018, he was appointed the Minister of National Education and Literacy, replacing [[Jean-Martin Coulibaly]].<ref>{{cite news |url=http://omegabf.info/politique/burkina-remaniement-ministeriel-stanislas-ouaro-ministre-de-leducation-nationale-et-de-lalphabetisation-le-president-du-luniversite-de-ouaga-ii-jusque-la-prend-la-place-de-jean-martin-coulib/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200324095931/http://omegabf.info/politique/burkina-remaniement-ministeriel-stanislas-ouaro-ministre-de-leducation-nationale-et-de-lalphabetisation-le-president-du-luniversite-de-ouaga-ii-jusque-la-prend-la-place-de-jean-martin-coulib/ |url-status=usurped |archive-date=March 24, 2020 |title=Ouaro, ministre de l'Education nationale et de l'alphabétisation. Le président du l'Université de Ouaga II jusque là prend la place de Jean Martin Coulibaly |publisher= omegabf.info | date= 31 January 2018 | language=fr}}</ref> On 19 January 2019, he [[2019 Burkina Faso government resignation|resigned]] together with other members of [[Paul Kaba Thieba|Thieba]] cabinet.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-46930537|title=Burkina Faso: Prime Minister and cabinet resign from office|date=19 January 2019 }}</ref> On 24 January, he was appointed the Minister of National Education, Literacy and Promotion of National Languages.<ref>{{cite news| url= https://lefaso.net/spip.php?article87654 |title=Burkina Faso : La composition du premier gouvernement de Christophe Dabiré dévoilée |work=lefaso.net |date=25 January 2019 |language=fr}}</ref>

==Health==
During the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Burkina Faso|2020 coronavirus outbreak]], on 21 March, Ouaro contracted the [[SARS-CoV-2|coronavirus]].<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-03-21/burkina-faso-mines-minister-tests-positive-for-coronavirus|title=Burkina Faso Mines Minister Tests Positive for Coronavirus|date=2020-03-21|work=Bloomberg.com|access-date=2020-03-21|language=en}}</ref>
